checks.name: Catalogue contains 1000 components with bounded mounted rows
runtime updates cause no palette commits or sorting
drag updates cause no palette commits or sorting
selection updates cause no palette commits or sorting
viewport updates cause no palette commits or sorting
Typing searches the cached catalogue within the 50 ms scheduling budget
Every catalogue item is reachable across bounded pages
Search resets the page and matches names, types and descriptions
Category browsing keeps every family accessible and search remains global
Collapsed categories cannot hide matching search results
Catalogue replacement clamps pagination and updates search entries
Coverage metadata updates retain badges without sorting the catalogue
Keyboard activation adds the correct component at the current viewport
Read-only mode keeps search available and prevents insertion and creation
Studio loads on demand and preserves drafts across close and reopen
Narrow palette retains visible paging controls without horizontal overflow

conditions.mode: Vite development with StrictMode; actual ComponentPanel, canvas store and custom studio; isolated query cache and blocked external requests
conditions.timing: Actual input event to second animation frame is a scheduling proxy, not pixel paint or total CPU attribution
